definitions.explanation: An astronomical phenomenon where the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth, partially or fully blocking the Sun's light.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}、{日食|にっしょく}が{起|お}こる。
examples.english: A solar eclipse will occur tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {皆既日食|かいきにっしょく}を{見|み}るために{旅行|りょこう}した。
examples.english: I traveled to see a total solar eclipse.

examples.japanese: {日食|にっしょく}を{直接|ちょくせつ}{見|み}ると{目|め}を{傷|いた}める。
examples.english: Looking directly at a solar eclipse can damage your eyes.

notes:
{日食|にっしょく} refers to a solar eclipse.

TYPES OF SOLAR ECLIPSES:
- {皆既日食|かいきにっしょく} (total solar eclipse)
- {部分日食|ぶぶんにっしょく} (partial solar eclipse)
- {金環日食|きんかんにっしょく} (annular solar eclipse)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日食|にっしょく}が{起|お}こる (a solar eclipse occurs)
- {日食|にっしょく}を{観測|かんそく}する (observe a solar eclipse)
- {日食|にっしょく}{メガネ|めがね} (eclipse glasses)

RELATED WORDS:
- {月食|げっしょく}: lunar eclipse
- {蝕|しょく}: eclipse (general term)
